static_traits.name: Chen Fang
static_traits.family_status: Lives with husband and two children; the family likes her cooking
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with other parents affected by inferiority; husband supportive and has friends to confide in, but has not yet discussed current troubles with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never had similar psychological problems before, has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, can concretely describe inner images (imagining being laughed at in an interview), coherent logic but overall emotional tone negative, low self-evaluation

basic_info.main_problem: Since becoming a Full-time homemaker, I have felt insecure and doubtful about my future employability, worsening in recent months. I believe the cause is lack of Work experience and worrying about not finding Work in the future. I often compare myself with working parents and feel inferior; these thoughts appear weekly, have affected my confidence and made daily activities hard to enjoy.
basic_info.core_demands: Realized these feelings are affecting my mental health and self-worth, so I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After becoming a Full-time homemaker, gradually developed insecurity and doubt about future employment, markedly worsening in recent months; believing lack of Work experience will make future hiring difficult, frequently comparing with working parents and feeling inferior; these feelings appear weekly and have affected relationships with other parents and enjoyment of activities like cooking and running; has a supportive husband and friends, but has not yet confided in them; No major physical illness history, no previous similar psychological problems or treatment history.

core_beliefs: I do not have enough ability/skill

special_situations.event: When interacting with working parents or thinking about their career achievements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as successful as other parents, it shows I am worthless, not worthy of respect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Subconsciously comparing with others to test self-worth; avoiding confiding in others, bearing inferiority and Anxiety alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be as successful as them

special_situations.event: Imagining oneself attending a job interview
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot answer questions or am laughed at, it proves I have no value and cannot possibly be hired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to Repress and deny related thoughts, avoiding discussion with family or friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The interviewer will laugh at me, I will not be able to answer anything

special_situations.event: When thinking about future Work prospects and financial independence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find Work, once something happens to the family I will be unable to support it, the consequences unbearable to imagine
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly envisioning worst-case scenarios to 'prepare' oneself, while continuing Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If an accident happens, I will also be unable to support the family

special_situations.event: When realizing one lacks formal work experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Not having continuous formal Work experience means nobody will hire me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Defining oneself with the label of 'no experience', ignoring transferable skills formed in household management and parenting
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nobody will hire me, who has no experience

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a sense of self-worth and others' recognition through work, and achieve a degree of financial independence
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being rejected, worrying about being belittled as an 'incapable/unworthy' person, even unable to take responsibility when the family faces misfortune
defense_goal: Maintaining fragile self-esteem stability through Repression and avoiding related thoughts
Staying Silent and not communicating with the support system to avoid exposing vulnerability and being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A 'weak person/failure' who is not good enough and may fail
object_relations.object_representation: Successful others who may judge and laugh at me (such as working parents, interviewers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about future job hunting or being invited to concretize interview scenarios
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will be as picky as interviewers and even laugh at me (negative presumption about others' intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lead with Empathy and validation, gently Clarify the difference between evidence and inference, invite examples and elaboration of feelings, avoid confrontational questioning.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When strong Anxiety thoughts about 'being unemployable' arise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I face these thoughts directly I will completely collapse, so I must suppress them
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using gentle, slow guidance anchored in body sensations to help label and hold emotions, encouraging the use of the phrase 'at this moment I notice...' to describe present experience.

manifestations: After becoming a Full-time homemaker, the sense of meaning about self-worth and social roles began to shake
Feeling 'not good enough/unworthy' after comparing with working parents
outcomes: Hard to enjoy daily activities like cooking and running

manifestations: Feeling uneasy about the choice and responsibilities of re-entering the workplace (such as financial independence)
Worries that once a choice is made, one must bear the failure consequences
outcomes: Avoiding initiating action and seeking information
Countering uncertainty with catastrophic rehearsal, Anxiety rising

manifestations: Although having a supportive husband and friends, has not yet discussed related troubles with them
Feeling isolated in comparison and Self-denial
outcomes: Social support not yet activated, maintaining the problem cycle
Impaired self-esteem and increased sense of helplessness

contact_model.definition: The individual suppresses or ignores their own needs, feelings and desires, to avoid discomfort or conflict.
manifestations: 'I try to ignore / push away these thoughts, but they always come back'
Avoiding talking about related topics when strongly uneasy

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes 'the success of working parents' as the only standard for measuring self-worth
negating the value of household-management and parenting skills on this basis

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Imagining the interviewer laughing at oneself, negating oneself
Attributes experiences of self-shame externally to others' negative evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 'Everything I do feels like a failure'-style harsh self-criticism
Restrained about expression and help-seeking, worries about being evaluated

positive_force: Has a supportive husband and friends (potential social support)
Transferable skills such as organization, coordination and problem-solving accumulated through household management and parenting
Family members' positive feedback on her cooking and efforts (resources and strengths)
Able to notice problems and proactively seek counseling help (motivation and self-help tendency)
negative_force: Self-deprecation and inferiority from frequent comparison
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization and predicting the future maintaining Anxiety
Uses 'lacking formal work experience' as a fixed self-label, ignoring positive evidence (mental filtering)
Avoiding expression and help-seeking, not yet able to activate Social support

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly thinking about future employment in a catastrophic way, accompanied by strong Self-doubt and Anxiety
antecedent: Thinking about future Work prospects and financial independence
Compares when interacting with working parents or recalling their career achievements
target_behavior.core_reason: Externalized dependence of self-worth and negative core beliefs ('I am not good enough/have no ability') activated in the context of lacking formal Work experience, forming a chain of catastrophic and overgeneralized thinking
target_behavior.function: Escaping the emotional discomfort brought by uncertainty and potential failure (gaining brief control by rehearsing worst outcomes)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence, Hard to enjoy daily activities like cooking and running, relationships with other parents affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing troubles to her husband or friends and seeking support
antecedent: When insecurity and shame about 'being unemployable' arise
Conversations or situations involving job hunting and ability evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged and rejected, tending to maintain fragile self-esteem through Repression and avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping exposing vulnerability and possible negative evaluation, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet activated, negative beliefs and Anxiety maintained or even Reinforced
